description: Create the requested single-platform tracking group; does not establish populated or fresh evidence. A group with the same name (trimmed, case-insensitive), platform and locale_key is returned instead of a duplicate, with reused_existing=true. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation, pricing, balance and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.

locale_key.description: Optional language-market key such as en-SG; part of the group identity.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this requested write; discover accessible context first.

name: socialseal_create_tracking_group
title: Create a tracking group
